findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.description:
Multiple production requests can read a nil cache before any acquires the write lock. Each then loads and parses the manifest in sequence, even after the first request has populated the cache. This unnecessarily serializes I/O during concurrent startup requests. A later failed load can also overwrite the successfully populated cache with nil.

After acquiring the write lock, recheck `entryPointAssetsCache` for non-development requests and return it if another caller has already populated it.

findings.title: Add regression coverage for concurrent cache access
findings.description:
The existing tests exercise manifest parsing and CDN URL rewriting, but none calls `GetWebAssets`. They therefore cannot detect regressions in the synchronization introduced here.

Add concurrent `GetWebAssets` tests suitable for running under `go test -race`, plus coverage that production calls reuse cached assets while development calls reload the manifest. Ensure tests reset the global cache safely so their results do not depend on execution order.
